blockingFindings.title: R5 Windows timeout path has no spec-local coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: An acceptance requirement is marked covered in the coverage artifact but has no corresponding executable spec-local test coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: R5 requires preserving the Windows timeout path behavior, but the only R5 test exercises normal close on a Linux supervisor. No test constructs the supervisor with a Windows platform or asserts the Windows timeout behavior remains unchanged.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local R5 test that exercises the Windows timeout path and asserts the expected timeout behavior.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement is marked covered in the coverage artifact but has no corresponding executable spec-local test coverage.
